title_en: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck
title_zh: 乌克兰袭击俄罗斯军事基地 称五架飞机被击中
summary: The Ukrainian General Staff says its forces struck an airbase in the Nizhny Novgorod region east of Moscow.
summary_zh: 乌克兰总参谋部表示，其部队袭击了莫斯科以东下诺夫哥罗德地区的一个空军基地。
body_en: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck | Russia-Ukraine war News | Al Jazeera
Share Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck on social media
Ukrainian forces have hit a major Russian military base east of Moscow, damaging five aircraft used to launch missiles and bombs, according to the Ukrainian General Staff.

Ukraine struck the Savasleyka airbase in the Nizhny Novgorod region, the General Staff said on Wednesday, adding that three MiG-31 jets were used to fire hypersonic missiles and two Su-34 fighter-bombers were damaged.

Russia did not immediately comment on the report by the General Staff, which said the Savasleyka airbase had been hit in the latest long-range attacks aimed at crippling Moscow’s war effort .

The operation followed a series of high-profile strikes by Ukrainian forces in recent days in which two Russian ships were hit in Libyan waters and a Russian vessel was struck in the Gulf of Finland .
Last week, Ukraine destroyed the road portion of Russia’s prized bridge to the Crimea peninsula after consecutive attacks.
Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and fighting has continued despite a renewed US-backed push to end what has become Europe’s worst conflict since World War II.
Kyiv is trying to dent Moscow’s military might as it struggles under a renewed campaign of attacks on its energy system and mounting Russian strikes on front-line cities.
Ukrainian forces are hunting Russian ballistic-missile launchers used to carry out many of those attacks, striking 16 over the past several months, Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara said this week.

Renewed Ukrainian drone attacks have cut Russian oil refineries’ processing volumes by 45 percent since late October, industry sources said this month. Kyiv has said it will stop striking Russian energy targets only when Moscow does the same.

社交媒体称乌克兰袭击了俄罗斯军事基地，五架飞机被击中
据乌克兰总参谋部称，乌克兰军队袭击了莫斯科以东的一个主要俄罗斯军事基地，损坏了五架用于发射导弹和炸弹的飞机。
乌克兰总参谋部周三表示，袭击了下诺夫哥罗德地区的萨瓦斯利卡空军基地，并补充说，三架米格 31 喷气式飞机被用来发射高超音速导弹，两架苏 34 战斗轰炸机受损。

俄罗斯没有立即对总参谋部的报告发表评论，该报告称萨瓦斯利卡空军基地在最近旨在削弱莫斯科战争努力的远程袭击中遭到袭击。
此次行动是在乌克兰军队最近几天进行一系列引人注目的袭击之后进行的，其中两艘俄罗斯船只在利比亚水域被击中，一艘俄罗斯船只在芬兰湾被击中。
上周，乌克兰在连续袭击后摧毁了俄罗斯通往克里米亚半岛的珍贵桥梁的部分道路。
俄罗斯于 2022 年 2 月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，尽管美国支持重新推动结束这场二战以来欧洲最严重的冲突，但战斗仍在继续。
基辅正试图削弱莫斯科的军事实力，因为俄罗斯在新一轮对其能源系统的攻击和俄罗斯对前线城市的袭击中陷入困境。
乌克兰国防部长叶夫尼·赫马拉 (Yevhenii Khmara) 本周表示，乌克兰军队正在追捕用于实施多次此类袭击的俄罗斯弹道导弹发射器，在过去几个月中袭击了 16 起。
行业消息人士本月表示，自 10 月底以来，乌克兰无人机的新一轮袭击已使俄罗斯炼油厂的加工量减少了 45%。基辅表示，只有当莫斯科也这样做时，它才会停止攻击俄罗斯的能源目标。

title_en: California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving
title_zh: 感恩节期间潮汐达到顶峰，加州警告洪水
summary: Parts of the Canadian province of British Columbia may also be affected by the storms and flooding, which come as millions of people travel for the holiday.
summary_zh: 加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的部分地区也可能受到风暴和洪水的影响，数百万人前往避暑。
body_en: Coastal areas of California are bracing for potential flooding as king tides peak in the state during the US Thanksgiving holiday.

Water levels across the US state's vast coastline could reach over 8ft (2.4 metres) in some areas on Wednesday and Thursday, according to the National Weather Service (NWS) - breaking records set just last month.
The NWS has warned parts of California could face major coastal flooding, which is likely to be significant in low-lying areas. There have already been some reports of flooding.
Meanwhile, storms are also forecast for the Pacific Northwest, including the Canadian province of British Columbia, and eastern parts of the US.
Portions of a pier in northern California came crashing down into the ocean on Wednesday as high tides and strong waves battered the structure, video showed.
Beachgoers have been advised to stay away from the water's edge as large waves could suddenly form. Such waves could be damaging to piers and jetties, and could capsize small vessels, the NWS warned.
Flooding has already been reported in the San Francisco Bay Area.

In San Diego, a high tide of 8 ft 11in was recorded on Wednesday morning local time - potentially breaking the record for highest tide measured in the area, which was just set late last month at 7.98ft.
In Los Angeles, the tide on Wednesday was thought to be as high 8.19 - the record for the city that was set only weeks ago 27 October when parts of the California coast experienced flooding.
Recently set high tide records were also broken in Santa Barbara and La Jolla, according to preliminary data.
King tides are the highest predicted tide of the year and are above the highest water level reached at high tide on an average day.

While they typically occur once or twice a year in most coastal areas, they are happening more frequently in some as sea levels rise. These king tides are being strengthened by the strongest El Niño weather pattern on record.

Storm systems are also expected to impact the US through the Thanksgiving holiday - one affecting the Pacific Northwest and another the eastern part of the country, the US National Weather Service said.
On the east coast, a developing Nor'easter storm is expected to bring heavy rain, strong winds, and coastal flooding.
Major impacts are expected to begin on Wednesday across the southeast, and move northward Wednesday night and on Thursday, the NWS said.
"Those along the eastern seaboard can expect gusty, possibly damaging winds, heavy rain, and major coastal and marine impacts," it added.
The developing storm system could bring about one to four inches rain along America's east coast and a peak of four to six inches in coastal North Carolina.

The US department store chain Macy's has postponed its 100th annual Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York, which was due to take place on Thursday, until Saturday because of severe weather - the first time this has happened.
The stormy weather on both coasts could disrupt travel for millions of people.
The American Automobile Association (AAA) has predicted that 81.5 million Americans will travel at least 50 miles (80km) from home for Thanksgiving between Tuesday 24 November and Monday 30 November.
body_zh: 美国感恩节期间，加州沿海地区正面临着可能发生的洪水，因为该州的潮汐达到顶峰。
据国家气象局 (NWS) 称，周三和周四，美国各州广阔海岸线的部分地区水位可能达到 8 英尺（2.4 米）以上，打破了上个月创下的记录。
美国国家气象局警告称，加州部分地区可能面临严重的沿海洪水，其中低洼地区可能会出现严重洪水。已经有一些关于洪水的报道。
与此同时，预计太平洋西北部地区（包括加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省和美国东部地区）也会出现风暴。
视频显示，周三，加州北部一座码头的部分设施因涨潮和巨浪的冲击而沉入大海。
建议海滩游客远离水边，因为可能会突然形成巨浪。国家气象局警告说，这样的波浪可能会损坏码头和防波堤，并可能导致小型船只倾覆。
据报道，旧金山湾区已发生洪水。
在圣地亚哥，当地时间周三早上记录到了 8 英尺 11 英寸的高潮，这可能会打破该地区测得的最高潮汐记录，该记录是上个月末刚刚创下的 7.98 英尺。
在洛杉矶，周三的潮汐被认为高达 8.19 度，这是该市几周前 10 月 27 日创下的最高纪录，当时加州海岸部分地区遭遇洪水。
根据初步数据，圣巴巴拉和拉霍亚最近创下的高潮记录也被打破。
王潮是一年中预测的最高潮汐，高于平均每天涨潮时达到的最高水位。
虽然它们通常在大多数沿海地区每年发生一到两次，但随着海平面上升，在一些地区发生的频率会更高。有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺天气模式正在加强这些王潮。
美国国家气象局表示，预计风暴系统还将在感恩节假期期间影响美国，其中一个影响太平洋西北地区，另一个影响该国东部地区。
在东海岸，正在发展的东北风暴预计将带来大雨、强风和沿海洪水。
国家气象局表示，预计主要影响将于周三开始穿过东南部，并在周三晚上和周四向北移动。
报告补充说：“东部沿海地区可能会出现阵风、可能具有破坏性的大风、大雨以及严重的沿海和海洋影响。”
正在发展的风暴系统可能会给美国东海岸带来一到四英寸的降雨，并为北卡罗来纳州沿海地区带来四到六英寸的峰值降雨量。
由于恶劣天气，美国连锁百货公司梅西百货将原定于周四在纽约举行的第 100 届年度感恩节游行推迟至周六，这是首次发生这种情况。
两岸的暴风雨天气可能会扰乱数百万人的出行。
美国汽车协会 (AAA) 预测，11 月 24 日星期二至 11 月 30 日星期一期间，8150 万美国人将离家至少行驶 50 英里（80 公里）过感恩节。

title_en: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
title_zh: 美国宣布对中国等多国加征新关税
summary: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.
summary_zh: 新关税将打击美国许多最大的贸易伙伴，包括中国和欧盟。
body_en: By Michael Race , Jonathan Josephs and Osmond Chia , Business reporters
The US has announced a fresh raft of tariffs as President Donald Trump pushes ahead with his signature trade policy.

The new taxes charged on imports to America are set to hit many of the country's biggest trading partners - China, the European Union and 12 other jurisdictions, including Japan, South Korea and Taiwan.
The White House began investigating the trade practices of other countries in March after the US Supreme Court ruled Trump's previously announced Liberation Day tariffs were illegal .
China is facing the highest tariff rate of up to 40%, followed by Vietnam at up to 35%, with others facing either 20% or 25%.
The US Trade Representative (USTR) announced the proposed tariffs together with extensive reports of how each jurisdiction's trade practices purportedly impact American commerce.
The new duties are not expected to take effect until next year and have to go through rounds of public consultation and, potentially, hearings.
Tariffs are taxes levied on imported goods. The amount is typically calculated as a percentage of a good's value and paid to the government by businesses importing products.
Some of these rates will be effectively reduced because of caps on tariffs Trump has agreed to. Individual countries also face different levies.
The proposed tariffs will affect goods from China, the European Union, Singapore, Switzerland, Indonesia, Malaysia, Cambodia, Thailand, Korea, Vietnam, Taiwan, Bangladesh, Japan, and India.
The USTR's Jamieson Greer said the latest tariffs issued would "level the playing field for American workers and chart a new, more sustainable course for the world economy".
He said that many of America's trading partners had "for decades" adopted industrial strategies which included "targeting manufacturing, wage and labor suppression".
They also employ "other market distorting practices that tilt the trade balance in their favour while eroding America's manufacturing base", Greer said.
But economists have warned tariffs can fuel inflation and push prices up for consumers if businesses pass on higher costs, as well as dampen global trade.
Trump has repeatedly threatened or imposed tariffs during his second term, arguing they will boost US manufacturing and create jobs.
Despite a poor result for the Republican party in the midterm elections, the president has continued to press on with his flagship trade policy.
Trump is also seeking to cut the US trade deficit - the gap between the value of goods it buys from other countries and those it sells to them.
These new levies are build on a "stronger legal foundation" under US law compared with Trump's April 2025 Liberation Day tariffs, Singapore Management University economics lecturer Chang Pao-Li said.

Trump previously invoked emergency presidential powers to impose tariffs that have since been struck down, while his latest approach relies on the USTR's authority to impose tariffs to address certain foreign trade practices, she said.
The levies are still likely to face legal challenges, but there has been a "historical precedent" for such tariffs remaining in force, Chang said.
body_zh: 作者：Michael Race、Jonathan Josephs 和 Osmond Chia，商业记者
随着唐纳德·特朗普总统推进其标志性贸易政策，美国宣布了一系列新的关税。
对美国进口产品征收的新税将打击该国许多最大的贸易伙伴——中国、欧盟以及日本、韩国和台湾等其他 12 个司法管辖区。
在美国最高法院裁定特朗普先前宣布的解放日关税非法后，白宫于三月份开始调查其他国家的贸易行为。
中国面临的关税最高，高达 40%，其次是越南，高达 35%，其他国家则面临 20% 或 25% 的关税。
美国贸易代表 (USTR) 宣布了拟议的关税，并发布了有关每个司法管辖区的贸易行为如何影响美国商业的大量报告。
新的职责预计要到明年才会生效，并且必须经过多轮公众咨询，并可能举行听证会。
关税是对进口商品征收的税款。该金额通常按商品价值的百分比计算，并由进口产品的企业支付给政府。
由于特朗普同意设定关税上限，其中一些税率将有效降低。各个国家也面临不同的征税。
拟议的关税将影响来自中国、欧盟、新加坡、瑞士、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、柬埔寨、泰国、韩国、越南、台湾、孟加拉国、日本和印度的商品。
美国贸易代表办公室的贾米森·格里尔表示，最新征收的关税将“为美国工人创造公平的竞争环境，并为世界经济制定一条新的、更可持续的路线”。
他表示，美国的许多贸易伙伴“几十年来”都采取了工业战略，其中包括“针对制造业、工资和劳动力压制”。
格里尔表示，他们还采用“其他扭曲市场的做法，使贸易平衡向有利于他们的方向倾斜，同时侵蚀美国的制造业基础”。
但经济学家警告称，如果企业转嫁更高的成本，关税可能会加剧通货膨胀，推高消费者的价格，并抑制全球贸易。
特朗普在第二任期内多次威胁或征收关税，称关税将提振美国制造业并创造就业机会。
尽管共和党在中期选举中成绩不佳，但总统仍继续推行其旗舰贸易政策。
特朗普还寻求削减美国的贸易逆差——即从其他国家购买的商品与向其他国家出售的商品之间的价值差距。
新加坡管理大学经济学讲师张保利表示，与特朗普 2025 年 4 月解放日关税相比，这些新关税建立在美国法律“更强有力的法律基础”之上。
她说，特朗普此前曾援引总统紧急权力来征收关税，但该权力后来被取消，而他的最新做法依赖于美国贸易代表办公室征收关税的权力，以解决某些外贸行为。
张说，这些关税仍可能面临法律挑战，但此类关税仍然有效是有“历史先例”的。

title_en: FedEx plane overshoots Miami runway, with flights briefly suspended at airport
title_zh: 联邦快递飞机冲出迈阿密跑道，机场航班短暂暂停
summary: The brief ground stop comes on the day before the US Thanksgiving holiday, one of the busiest travel days of the year.
summary_zh: 这次短暂的地面停留是在美国感恩节假期的前一天，这是一年中最繁忙的旅行日之一。
body_en: FedEx plane overshoots Miami runway, causing temporary ground stop at airport - BBC News
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has halted flights bound for Miami International Airport in Florida after a FedEx aircraft overran a runway on Wednesday evening.

Departures heading to Miami were grounded just after 20:15 local time (01:15 GMT) and all but one runway at the airport was closed, according to the FAA advisory. Flights are expected to resume by around 22:00 local time, the FAA told the BBC.
The airliner that ran past the runway arrived from Memphis. No injuries have been reported. The FAA is investigating the incident.
The ground stop comes on the day before Thanksgiving, one of the busiest travel days of the year in the US.
Flight delays in Miami reached one hour but appeared to be declining later Wednesday night.
Passengers scheduled to travel on Wednesday night were encouraged to check directly with their airlines for the latest flight updates before heading to the airport.
"We appreciate our passengers' patience as we work to safely resume normal operations," Miami-Dade Aviation Department spokesman Greg Chin said in a statement to the BBC.
The airport is among the top five domestic destinations for travelers in the country over this holiday week, according to the American Automobile Association.
The Miami-Dade area is under a flood watch until late Wednesday night. Periods of heavy rain throughout the day are expected to cause flooding, according to the US National Weather Service.
A nationwide ground stop earlier this month halted flights across the US for hours - the longest such event since the terror attacks on 11 September 2001.

body_zh: 联邦快递飞机冲出迈阿密跑道，导致机场暂时停止 -_澳门赌博平台
周三晚上，一架联邦快递飞机冲出跑道后，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）已暂停飞往佛罗里达州迈阿密国际机场的航班。
根据美国联邦航空局的通报，当地时间 20:15（格林威治标准时间 01:15）刚过，飞往迈阿密的航班停飞，机场除一条跑道外的所有航班均已关闭。 FAA 告诉 BBC，航班预计将在当地时间 22:00 左右恢复。
冲过跑道的客机从孟菲斯起飞。目前还没有人员受伤的报告。美国联邦航空局正在调查这一事件。
地面站是感恩节前一天，感恩节是美国一年中最繁忙的旅行日之一。
迈阿密的航班延误达一小时，但周三晚间延误情况似乎有所减少。
我们鼓励计划于周三晚上出行的乘客在前往机场之前直接向航空公司查询最新航班信息。
迈阿密戴德航空部门发言人格雷格·钦（Greg Chin）在给英国广播公司（BBC）的一份声明中表示：“我们感谢乘客在我们努力安全恢复正常运营过程中的耐心等待。”
根据美国汽车协会的数据，该机场是这个假期周内该国旅客最喜欢的五个国内目的地之一。
迈阿密戴德地区一直处于洪水警戒状态，直到周三深夜。据美国国家气象局称，全天的大雨预计将导致洪水。
本月早些时候，全美范围内的地面停飞导致全美各地的航班停运数小时，这是自 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击以来持续时间最长的此类事件。

title_en: Ukraine confirms it used naval drones to strike two Russian ships off Libya
title_zh: 乌克兰证实使用海军无人机袭击了利比亚附近的两艘俄罗斯船只
summary: Ukraine’s security service says seven drones were launched from mothership in operation that sank Merkury warship Ukraine has confirmed it deployed naval drones in strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya on Sunday, including one that sank the corvette Merkury
summary_zh: 乌克兰安全部门表示，在击沉水星号军舰的行动中，有七架无人机从母舰上发射，乌克兰已确认部署了无人机
body_en: Ukraine’s security service says seven drones were launched from mothership in operation that sank Merkury warship
Ukraine has confirmed it deployed naval drones in strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya on Sunday, including one that sank the corvette Merkury, one of Russia’s newest vessels.
Ukraine’s security service, the SBU, said seven domestically made naval drones were launched from a mothership in the operation, which Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as “exemplary”.
“We continue our operations in designated waters. We are responding to Russia’s aggression. We are developing Ukrainian weapons,” the Ukrainian president added.

Zelenskyy released video footage, filmed by an approaching drone, showing the drones as they smashed into the side of the warship at its berth in the Benghazi naval base, triggering huge explosions that lit up the night sky.

In its own statement, the SBU said: “The defence forces of Ukraine have once again demonstrated that the Russian military fleet and its logistics networks have no safe routes, even far beyond the Black Sea.”
Zelenskyy said the other vessel hit on Sunday, the dry cargo ship MV Angara, was being used by Russia to transport weapons.

The operation, conducted 1,500 miles (2,400km) from the frontline in Ukraine, was the latest daring long-range assault by Kyiv’s forces. Last week Ukraine hit the Kerch bridge – a key supply line to Russian-occupied Crimea – and the Russian Baltic seaport of Kaliningrad.
Residents in Benghazi heard loud explosions and saw flames at the naval base early on Sunday. Civil defence units rushed to the site and extinguished the fire, authorities in eastern Libya said.

The Institute for the Study of War said the Merkury had stopped over for several days, under a cooperation agreement, to refuel and resupply as it escorted Russian cargo ships that could carry military supplies en route to Russia.

The Merkury had docked to refuel and take on supplies as part of a cooperation agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, the statement said without providing details about the vessel or its cargo.

Vladimir Putin had taken a personal interest in the ship. In 2019 he toured the St Petersburg yard where it was being built and backed naming it after a tsarist-era brig celebrated for fighting off two Turkish warships in the Black Sea in 1829.

At the 2023 Navy Day parade, the Russian president singled it out among 30 new vessels as evidence that Russia was “consistently building up the power of its fleet”. He hailed its St George flag as “a sign of the inviolability of our naval traditions” and said it was “gratifying” that the brig’s name had been revived.
Russian state media also talked up the ship. The news agency Tass called it the “newest missile corvette”, while the channel TV Tsentr claimed its stealth technology made it “invisible to radar”.

Divided Libya has emerged in recent years as a proxy battlefield. Moscow has long supported the breakaway government in Benghazi of Khalifa Haftar in its efforts to use eastern Libya as a staging post for its military presence in north Africa and the Sahel.

More recently there have been reports of increasing Ukrainian operations. In April, Associated Press reported that Ukrainian drone specialists had been operating at military sites in Misrata, Tripoli and Zawiya in Libya’s west. In September Libyan authorities denied reports by CNN that it allowed Ukraine to use a military base to launch drones against vessels from Russia’s “shadow fleet” in the Mediterranean.

The confirmation that Ukraine was behind the attacks was condemned by the UN-recognised government in Tripoli. It said Libya rejected ⁠any foreign ⁠military ​operations on its territory or in its waters.

There was no immediate comment from Russia about the strikes. The UN mission in Libya (UNSMIL), however, expressed “serious concern” over the attacks, calling for “an immediate, independent and transparent investigation”. It said on X: “Libya cannot afford, and must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts.”

Ukraine prides itself on its military industry, particularly its progress in drone technology, which it has extensively developed since Russia invaded more than four and a half years ago. It has repeatedly touted the effectiveness of its domestically produced drones, including naval drones deployed throughout the war to hit Russian ships and infrastructure in the Black Sea.
body_zh: 乌克兰安全部门表示，七架无人机从母舰上发射，击沉了水星号军舰
乌克兰证实周日部署海军无人机袭击了利比亚附近的两艘俄罗斯船只，其中一艘击沉了俄罗斯最新舰艇之一的护卫舰“水星号”。
乌克兰安全部门 SBU 表示，在这次行动中，七架国产海军无人机从一艘母舰上发射，弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基称此次行动为“典范”。
“我们继续在指定水域开展行动。我们正在回应俄罗斯的侵略。我们正在开发乌克兰武器，”他说。
泽伦斯基发布了由一架接近的无人机拍摄的视频片段，显示无人机撞向停泊在班加西海军基地的军舰侧面，引发巨大爆炸，照亮了夜空。
SBU在自己的声明中表示：“乌克兰国防军再次证明，俄罗斯军事舰队及其后勤网络没有安全路线，甚至远离黑海。”
泽连斯基表示，周日被击中的另一艘干货船“安加拉号”(MV Angara) 正被俄罗斯用来运输武器。
这次行动是在距离乌克兰前线 1,500 英里（2,400 公里）处进行的，是基辅部队最新一次大胆的远程攻击。上周，乌克兰袭击了刻赤大桥（通往俄罗斯占领的克里米亚的重要补给线）和俄罗斯波罗的海港口加里宁格勒。
周日早些时候，班加西的居民听到巨大的爆炸声，并看到海军基地起火。利比亚东部当局表示，民防部队赶到现场并扑灭了大火。
战争研究所表示，根据一项合作协议，“水星号”在护送俄罗斯货船前往俄罗斯途中停留了几天，以补充燃料和补给。
声明称，作为俄罗斯与利比亚东部政府之间合作协议的一部分，“水星”号已停靠停靠以加油和接收补给，但没有提供有关该船或其货物的详细信息。
弗拉基米尔·普京对这艘船产生了个人兴趣。 2019 年，他参观了正在建造的圣彼得堡造船厂，并支持以一艘沙皇时代的双桅船命名，该双桅船曾于 1829 年在黑海击退了两艘土耳其军舰。
在 2023 年海军日阅兵式上，俄罗斯总统在 30 艘新舰艇中特别挑选了它，作为俄罗斯“不断增强其舰队力量”的证据。他称赞其圣乔治旗是“我们海军传统不可侵犯的标志”，并表示双桅船的名字得以恢复是“令人欣慰的”。
俄罗斯官方媒体也对这艘船进行了谈论。塔斯社称其为“最新的导弹护卫舰”，而 TV Tsentr 频道则声称其隐形技术使其“雷达看不见”。
近年来，分裂的利比亚已成为代理人战场。莫斯科长期以来一直支持哈利法·哈夫塔尔领导的班加西分裂政府利用利比亚东部作为其在北非和萨赫勒地区军事存在的中转站。
最近有报道称乌克兰业务有所增加。 4 月，美联社报道称，乌克兰无人机专家一直在利比亚西部米苏拉塔、的黎波里和扎维耶的军事基地开展行动。 9月，利比亚当局否认了美国有线电视新闻网(CNN)的报道，称该国允许乌克兰利用军事基地向地中海的俄罗斯“影子舰队”船只发射无人机。
确认乌克兰是此次袭击的幕后黑手，受到联合国承认的的黎波里政府的谴责。声明称，利比亚拒绝任何外国在其领土或水域进行军事行动。
俄罗斯没有立即对此次袭击发表评论。然而，联合国驻利比亚特派团（联利支助团）对袭击表示“严重关切”，呼吁“立即进行独立和透明的调查”。它在X上表示：“利比亚无力承担，也决不能成为外国冲突的战场。”
乌克兰为其军事工业感到自豪，特别是其在无人机技术方面的进步，自俄罗斯四年半前入侵以来，乌克兰已广泛开发了无人机技术。它一再吹捧其国产无人机的有效性，包括在整个战争期间部署的海军无人机，用于攻击黑海的俄罗斯船只和基础设施。

title_en: Lululemon founder stuns Canadian women’s leadership conference with sexist comments
title_zh: Lululemon创始人发表性别歧视言论震惊加拿大女性领导力会议
summary: Chip Wilson said men importing brides from Thailand was due to women waiting too long to have children The controversial founder of Lululemon suggested women in Canada are having too few children and this could lead some men to bring in brides from Thailand ,
summary_zh: 奇普·威尔逊 (Chip Wilson) 表示，男性从泰国引进新娘是因为女性等待生育时间太长。备受争议的 Lululemon 创始人建议
body_en: Chip Wilson said men importing brides from Thailand was due to women waiting too long to have children

The controversial founder of Lululemon suggested women in Canada are having too few children and this could lead some men to bring in brides from Thailand , in remarks that stunned audience members at a women’s leadership conference.

Chip Wilson, who built the Vancouver yoga-wear startup into a global athleisure empire, was a featured speaker at the Leadership Forum in Calgary earlier this week, an event organized by Axis Connects to advance women in leadership. The organization says it aims to create space for “candid conversations about the barriers women face both in business and society”.

Wilson’s talk on 23 November, titled “Little Black Stretchy Pants” after his memoir, was billed as an “intimate, fireside chat” offering insight into the “mind and instincts of the man himself”. It was moderated by Nuvyn Peters, CEO of Axis Connects.
Lululemon apologises after Japanese drum row at Great Wall yoga event

There is no publicly available video of the event, but the Guardian spoke with people who attended it and reviewed social media posts from those present. Outrage over the event was first reported by the Globe and Mail.

According to people who were there, Wilson told the audience that companies would be reluctant to hire a 22-year-old woman because she might become pregnant at 23 and take maternity leave. He went on to suggest that women were waiting too long to have children, prompting men to import brides from Thailand.
“There were audible gasps in the room and everyone was clearly uncomfortable. It was a mix of disengaging, walking out and also just complete shock of what was being said on stage,” one person said.

“I am floored that Axis gave this man a platform. We all were saying before the event it was surprising he was there – and it’s clear that [Wilson] runs in the organizer’s circles after she opened with the fact that they go on walks [at a Vancouver mountain] together.”
The event, which was supposed to run for an hour, was cut short at 45 minutes.

The remarks are not the first time Wilson has attracted criticism for his comments about women and their bodies. He stepped down as chair of Lululemon’s board in 2013 after the company’s signature black yoga pants were criticized for being see-through and Wilson blamed the problem on the body types of some customers.
On Monday, he reportedly told the group that those prior comments about body types had been “misconstrued” and said he was referring to women who wear sizes that are too small.
Wilson, who is believed to be worth more than C$6bn , has not had a leadership role at Lululemon for several years but remains a major shareholder.
He also reportedly told the audience that poverty had largely been eradicated, and that he was looking forward to going to space with Elon Musk.

Audience members also said Wilson suggested that men were better suited to helm clothing companies that catered to women, because they knew what looked good on women’s bodies. He said the same was true of women who lead companies focused on men’s fashion.

“We recognize that several comments made by Chip Wilson at the Leadership Forum were offensive and inconsistent with the values and mission of Axis Connects,” Peters said in a statement. “We understand why those remarks caused concern and disappointment among members of our community. His comments also underscore an uncomfortable reality: attitudes and assumptions that hold women back in the workplace and in leadership have not disappeared. Challenging those attitudes is central to the work and ethos of Axis Connects.”

Wilson’s spokesperson pointed to the work the Lululemon founder has done to mentor and “empower” women in leadership roles over the years and said his efforts “speak for themselves”. A number of women who were early employees of the company and worked closely with Wilson became millionaires when the company went public, he has previously noted in his memoir, and have gone on to found their own businesses.

More than 700 women attended the conference, many representing organizations they worked for. One person said the experience left her “irate”, adding that it was also indicative of what women continued to tolerate.
“It’s just sad that this is what women still have to deal with, in a forum literally for women.”
body_zh: 奇普·威尔逊表示，男性从泰国引进新娘是因为女性等待生育时间太长
这位备受争议的 Lululemon 创始人表示，加拿大女性生育的孩子太少，这可能会导致一些男性从泰国引进新娘，他的言论震惊了一次女性领导力会议上的观众。
奇普·威尔逊 (Chip Wilson) 将温哥华瑜伽服初创公司打造成全球运动休闲帝国，本周早些时候，他在卡尔加里领导力论坛上发表了演讲，该论坛是由 Axis Connects 组织的，旨在提升女性领导力。该组织表示，其目标是为“关于女性在商业和社会中面临的障碍的坦诚对话”创造空间。
威尔逊 11 月 23 日的演讲以他的回忆录命名为“小黑弹力裤”，被宣传为“亲密的炉边谈话”，提供了对“这个人本人的思想和本能”的洞察。会议由 Axis Connects 首席执行官 Nuvyn Peters 主持。
Lululemon为长城瑜伽活动中的日本鼓争吵道歉
目前还没有该活动的公开视频，但《卫报》采访了参加活动的人，并查看了出席者的社交媒体帖子。 《环球邮报》首先报道了对这一事件的愤怒。
据在场人士透露，威尔逊告诉观众，公司不愿意雇用一名 22 岁的女性，因为她可能会在 23 岁时怀孕并休产假。他接着表示，女性等待生育的时间太长，促使男性从泰国进口新娘。
“房间里可以听到喘息声，每个人显然都感到不舒服。这既是脱离接触，又是走出去，又是对台上所说的话感到完全震惊，”一位人士说。
“我对 Axis 为这个人提供了一个平台感到震惊。在活动开始前我们都说他的出现令人惊讶 - 很明显，在组织者开场后，[Wilson] 就在组织者的圈子里跑来跑去，事实是他们一起（在温哥华的一座山上）散步。”
该活动原定持续一小时，但被缩短为 45 分钟。
这并不是威尔逊第一次因对女性及其身体的评论而受到批评。 2013 年，在该公司标志性的黑色瑜伽裤因透明而受到批评后，威尔逊辞去了 Lululemon 董事会主席的职务，威尔逊将此问题归咎于一些顾客的体型。
据报道，周一，他告诉该组织，之前有关体型的评论被“误解”，并表示他指的是穿着尺码太小的女性。
威尔逊的身家据信超过 60 亿加元，他已多年不再担任 Lululemon 的领导职务，但仍是主要股东。
据报道，他还告诉观众，贫困已经基本消除，他期待着与埃隆·马斯克一起前往太空。
观众还表示，威尔逊建议男性更适合掌舵面向女性的服装公司，因为他们知道什么最适合女性的身体。他表示，对于领导专注于男士时尚的公司的女性来说也是如此。
彼得斯在一份声明中表示：“我们认识到奇普·威尔逊在领导力论坛上发表的一些言论具有攻击性，并且不符合 Axis Connects 的价值观和使命。” “我们理解为什么这些言论引起了我们社区成员的担忧和失望。他的言论还强调了一个令人不安的现实：阻碍女性在工作场所和领导层中发挥作用的态度和假设并没有消失。挑战这些态度是 Axis Connects 工作和精神的核心。”
威尔逊的发言人指出了这位 Lululemon 创始人多年来为指导和“赋权”担任领导职务的女性所做的工作，并表示他的努力“不言而喻”。威尔逊此前在回忆录中曾指出，公司上市后，许多曾是公司早期员工并与威尔逊密切合作的女性成为了百万富翁，并随后创办了自己的企业。
700 多名女性参加了会议，其中许多代表她们所工作的组织。一位人士表示，这次经历让她“愤怒”，并补充说，这也表明了女性继续容忍的事情。
“令人遗憾的是，在一个真正为女性而设的论坛上，这仍然是女性必须面对的问题。”

title_en: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
title_zh: 以色列法官建议撤销对内塔尼亚胡最严重的指控
summary: The Israeli PM says his trial should end after judges said there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases.
summary_zh: 以色列总理表示，法官表示三起案件中的一起几乎没有定罪的机会，因此他的审判应该结束。
body_en: Judges in Israel have suggested prosecutors drop bribery charges against Benjamin Netanyahu, potentially handing the caretaker prime minister a boost as he fights for his political survival.

The judges told the attorney general that there was little chance of conviction in the first of three cases he is facing, in which he is accused of granting government favours in exchange for positive media coverage.
They also questioned whether his actions amounted to criminal conduct in a second corruption case, and suggested prosecutors seek a plea deal in a third.
Netanyahu has consistently denied the allegations against him and called on Wednesday for the trial to be ended "immediately".
"Ten years of terrible suffering for me, my family, my son," he said in a televised statement.
"Ten years of incitement to hatred that wounds the soul."
Netanyahu was first charged in 2019, but court proceedings have been prolonged in part by the recent Israel-Gaza war.

The case now under serious doubt, known as Case 4,000, concerns an alleged "reciprocal arrangement" between Netanyahu and the controlling shareholder in Israel's biggest telecoms company. Both denied any wrongdoing.
In a highly unusual step, a judging panel at the Jerusalem District Court summoned Israeli Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara on Wednesday to express their concerns.
"The chances of conviction are low – to an extent that warrants reconsidering the matter," Judge Rivka Friedman-Feldman told her, Israeli media reported.

The judges also cast doubt on whether Netanyahu's actions, which are subject to a second case – concerning another alleged quid-pro-quo with another media baron, known as Case 2,000 – met the threshold for criminality.

While they left open the possibility of a conviction in the third case: Case 1,000, which alleges Netanyahu acted for the benefit of an Australian billionaire after being gifted cigars and champagne by him.
However, the judges told the attorney general that, in the public interest, there needed to be a "rethink" in how the trial should move forward, Israeli media report.
Baharav-Miara said she would consider the judges' recommendations.
It has been six years since Netanyahu became Israel's first sitting prime minister to face a criminal trial.
He has always claimed to be the victim of a political witch-hunt and said on Wednesday that the "fabricated cases" against him were now falling apart.

The cases have continued to progress in court while Netanyahu remained in power throughout the war in Gaza, though judges agreed to reduce the number of hearings due to security concerns around the conflict.
The accusations against him have rocked Israeli politics, fuelling already deep divisions. His trial has coincided with controversial, far-reaching judiciary reforms by Netanyahu's government.
For his opponents, Netanyahu's fear of prison has distorted his decision-making as prime minister and made him especially dependent on his far-right coalition partners to remain in power.

This latest development will give a boost to Netanyahu, whose political opponent Gadi Eisenkot is currently attempting to form a coalition government after an inconclusive general election last month.
body_zh: 以色列法官建议检察官撤销对本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的贿赂指控，这可能会给这位看守总理争取政治生存的机会带来推动。
法官告诉总检察长，他面临的三起案件中的第一起被定罪的可能性很小，在这起案件中，他被指控给予政府好处以换取媒体的积极报道。
他们还质疑他的行为在第二起腐败案件中是否构成犯罪行为，并建议检察官在第三起腐败案件中寻求认罪协议。
内塔尼亚胡一直否认对他的指控，并于周三呼吁“立即”结束审判。
他在电视声明中说：“我、我的家人、我的儿子经历了十年的可怕痛苦。”
“十年煽动仇恨，伤害灵魂。”
内塔尼亚胡于 2019 年首次受到指控，但由于最近的以色列-加沙战争，法庭审理时间有所延长。
该案被称为“Case 4,000”，目前受到严重质疑，涉及内塔尼亚胡与以色列最大电信公司控股股东之间所谓的“互惠安排”。两人均否认有任何不当行为。
耶路撒冷地方法院的一个评审小组周三传唤以色列总检察长加利·巴哈拉夫-米亚拉（Gali Baharav-Miara），表达了他们的担忧，这是极不寻常的一步。
据以色列媒体报道，法官里夫卡·弗里德曼-费尔德曼告诉她：“定罪的可能性很低，以至于需要重新考虑此事。”
法官们还对内塔尼亚胡的行为是否达到犯罪门槛表示怀疑，该行为属于第二起案件——涉及另一起涉嫌与另一位媒体大亨进行交换的案件，即“2000号案件”。
虽然他们保留了对第三起案件定罪的可能性：案件1,000，该案指控内塔尼亚胡在收到一位澳大利亚亿万富翁赠送的雪茄和香槟后，为他的利益行事。
然而，据以色列媒体报道，法官告诉司法部长，为了公共利益，需要“重新思考”审判应如何进行。
巴哈拉夫-米亚拉表示，她会考虑法官的建议。
内塔尼亚胡成为以色列第一位面临刑事审判的在任总理已有六年了。
他一直声称自己是政治迫害的受害者，并于周三表示，针对他的“捏造案件”现已分崩离析。
在内塔尼亚胡在加沙战争期间继续掌权期间，案件在法庭上继续取得进展，不过出于冲突的安全考虑，法官同意减少听证会的次数。
针对他的指控震动了以色列政坛，加剧了本已很深的分歧。对他的审判恰逢内塔尼亚胡政府进行有争议的、影响深远的司法改革。
对于他的对手来说，内塔尼亚胡对监狱的恐惧扭曲了他作为总理的决策，并使他特别依赖极右翼联盟伙伴来继续掌权。
这一最新进展将给内塔尼亚胡带来提振，内塔尼亚胡的政治对手加迪·艾森科特在上个月大选没有结果后目前正试图组建联合政府。

title_en: Peter Magyar meets Volodymyr Zelenskyy: Hungary and Ukraine make a fresh start after the icy relations of the Viktor Orban era
title_zh: 彼得·马扎尔会见弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基：匈牙利和乌克兰在欧尔班维克多时代的冰冷关系后重新开始
summary: After years of frosty and hostile relations under Hungary's Kremlin-friendly former PM Viktor Orban, his successor, Peter Magyar, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy seek to reset their countries' ties.
summary_zh: 在对克里姆林宫友好的匈牙利前总理维克托·欧尔班、他的继任者彼得·马扎尔和乌克兰总统的领导下，关系经历了多年的冷淡和敌对关系。
body_en: The location and the gesture were carefully chosen: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stood side by side, laid flowers and bowed their heads at the military cemetery in the center of the Ukrainian city of Uzhhorod.
One of those buried there is an ethnic Hungarian who was one of the first soldiers killed in Russia's full-scale war of aggression against Ukraine .

Magyar intentionally chose not to begin his first visit to Ukraine as prime minister at a government building. Instead, his Tuesday afternoon visit began at a place where he could demonstrate his solidarity with Ukraine more clearly than anywhere else.

Uzhhorod, known as Ungvar in Hungarian, is the capital of Ukraine's Transcarpathia region, which is home to around 80,000 members of Ukraine's Hungarian minority. Thousands of ethnic Hungarians are fighting Russian occupying forces on the front lines.
For Hungary , where ethnic Hungarian minorities in neighboring countries traditionally play an important role, the war is therefore closer to home than it is for other European countries.

Magyar described his visit to Ukraine as a "historic day" in a Facebook post. Before the ceremony at the cemetery in Uzhhorod, he said: "I bring with me the solidarity of the Hungarian people. We stand with Ukraine against the Russian aggressor."
Zelenskyy responded on X, saying "We appreciate this gesture of respect toward those who sacrificed their lives for Ukraine's independence."
The meeting between Magyar and Zelenskyy marked a turning point in Hungary's approach to Ukraine.

The two leaders repeatedly shook hands throughout the day. Such scenes would have been unthinkable just a few months ago. The propaganda of Magyar's pro-Russian predecessor, Viktor Orban , portrayed Ukraine as a "mafia state" and "lawless country" on an almost daily basis.
Under Orban, relations between Hungary and Ukraine reached a historic low .

Now the two countries are seeking a political reset, which is important not only for Hungary and Ukraine but for Europe as a whole. After all, Orban's repeated obstruction of support for Ukraine drove the EU to the brink of despair.
During talks in Uzhhorod, the two leaders also agreed to closer economic cooperation.

The talks centered on Hungarian diesel supplies to Ukraine, greater use of Ukrainian gas storage facilities by Hungarian companies, and joint infrastructure projects, including the opening of new border crossings and a direct rail link between Budapest and Kyiv.
Nevertheless, no formal agreements were signed on Tuesday.
At a subsequent news conference, journalists asked questions about sensitive issues between the two countries: minority rights, Ukraine's EU integration and a new EU loan for Ukraine.
Throughout the day, the two men were visibly keen to avoid any discord.

Magyar, for example, described his angry outburst over Ukraine's "Carpathian Eight" initiative in parliament in late September as a "misunderstanding" and suggested that Hungary might, after all, take part.
Zelenskyy's cautious replies to journalists suggest that he knows his country's path to EU membership also runs through Budapest.
One of Magyar's statements on Tuesday was key: "We've finally put a stop to this completely unnecessary and inexplicable political escalation."
Even before taking office in early May 2026, Magyar had promised to reset relations with Ukraine. But the process has not been entirely smooth.
body_zh: 地点和姿态都经过精心选择：匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔和乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在乌克兰乌日霍罗德市中心的军人公墓并肩站立，敬献鲜花并鞠躬。
其中埋葬者中有一名匈牙利裔，他是俄罗斯全面侵略乌克兰战争中第一批阵亡的士兵之一。
马扎尔故意选择不在政府大楼开始他作为总理对乌克兰的首次访问。相反，他周二下午的访问是在一个比其他任何地方都能更清楚地表明他对乌克兰的声援的地方开始的。
乌日霍罗德在匈牙利语中被称为 Ungvar，是乌克兰 Transcarpathia 地区的首府，该地区居住着大约 80,000 名乌克兰匈牙利少数民族成员。数以千计的匈牙利人正在前线与俄罗斯占领军作战。
对于匈牙利来说，邻国的匈牙利少数民族传统上发挥着重要作用，因此战争比其他欧洲国家更接近本国。
马扎尔在脸书上发帖称他对乌克兰的访问是“历史性的一天”。在乌日霍罗德公墓举行仪式之前，他说：“我带着匈牙利人民的团结。我们与乌克兰站在一起，反对俄罗斯侵略者。”
泽连斯基在 X 上回应称，“我们感谢这种对那些为乌克兰独立而牺牲的人们的尊重。”
马扎尔和泽伦斯基之间的会面标志着匈牙利对乌克兰态度的转折点。
两国领导人全天多次握手。这样的场景在几个月前还是不可想象的。马扎尔亲俄前任维克多·欧尔班的宣传几乎每天都将乌克兰描绘成“黑手党国家”和“无法无天的国家”。
在欧尔班的领导下，匈牙利和乌克兰的关系跌至历史低点。
现在两国正在寻求政治重置，这不仅对匈牙利和乌克兰而且对整个欧洲都很重要。毕竟，欧尔班一再阻挠对乌克兰的支持，让欧盟陷入了绝望的边缘。
在乌日霍罗德会谈期间，两国领导人还同意加强经济合作。
会谈的重点是匈牙利向乌克兰供应柴油、匈牙利公司更多地使用乌克兰天然气储存设施以及联合基础设施项目，包括开设新的过境点以及布达佩斯和基辅之间的直达铁路。
尽管如此，周二并未签署正式协议。
在随后的新闻发布会上，记者就两国之间的敏感问题提出了问题：少数民族权利、乌克兰融入欧盟以及欧盟向乌克兰提供的新贷款。
一整天，这两个人显然都热衷于避免任何不和。
例如，马扎尔将他9月下旬在议会中对乌克兰“喀尔巴阡八强”倡议的愤怒情绪描述为“误解”，并暗示匈牙利最终可能会参与其中。
泽伦斯基对记者的谨慎回答表明，他知道他的国家加入欧盟的道路也经过布达佩斯。
马扎尔周二的声明之一至关重要：“我们终于制止了这种完全不必要且莫名其妙的政治升级。”
甚至在 2026 年 5 月上旬上任之前，马扎尔就已承诺重置与乌克兰的关系。但这个过程并不完全顺利。

title_en: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show
title_zh: 记录显示，特朗普的账户今年交易了 Nvidia 股票 44 次
summary: A review of the US president's financial disclosures shows Donald Trump's investment portfolios have regularly traded shares in the tech giant.
summary_zh: 对美国总统财务披露的审查显示，唐纳德·特朗普的投资组合经常交易这家科技巨头的股票。
body_en: By Thomas Copeland and Alison Benjamin , BBC Verify
Donald Trump's investment portfolios have bought or sold shares in chipmaker Nvidia at least 44 times this year, a review of the US president's financial disclosures shows.

Trump's most recent public declarations of his investment trading show that between January and September the portfolios purchased between $5.2m and $17m (£4m and £13m) in Nvidia stock - and sold between $4.4m and $12m. His portfolios held between $12.5m and $58m of Nvidia shares at the end of 2025.
Financial disclosures to the Office of Government Ethics report a low and high range of transaction values, so a more precise analysis of how much Nvidia stock was traded is not possible.

The period of recent turmoil at Nvidia and volatility in its share price is not covered by the disclosures. In the last two weeks, co-founder and chief executive Jensen Huang resigned and then Trump played a significant part in his reinstatement.

The White House has said that Trump's stock and bond portfolio is independently managed by third parties and neither he nor his family "has any ability to direct, influence or provide input regarding how the portfolio is invested or when investments are bought or sold".

Huang resigned on 12 November after reports of extramarital affairs, including with one woman who has alleged ties to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia's share price dived following news of his resignation.
But on Monday Nvidia's board announced the 63-year-old was being reinstated as CEO.

Trump told US media he had "made the deal" to "convince" the tech giant's board to bring Huang back. The board said it had "received input from senior levels of the United States government" that he posed "no national security risk".

Nvidia's share price surged 31% on Monday following Huang's return. About $1tn (£763bn) was added to Nvidia's market value, but the company's shares are still trading below their value before reports of Huang's alleged affairs began to circulate.

However, concerns remain among both Republican and Democratic politicians about Huang's actions and Nvidia's compliance with US controls over the export of advanced computer chips to China, as well as Trump's involvement in getting him reappointed as CEO.
Nvidia's chip technology and investments have been critical to the growth of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry , leading to it becoming one of the world's most valuable companies.

The firm now represents more than 6% of the S&P 500 share index, according to State Street financial services. This makes it the second most valuable company on the index after Apple, whose shares Trump's accounts also frequently trade.
Nvidia also ranks highly in many global indices, meaning that investment accounts held around the world, including pensions, are likely to include its shares.
Our analysis of Trump's Nvidia trades does not include other investment products held by him which may include its shares.
Trump made at least $2.2bn (£1.7bn) from a variety of investments and commercial activities, according to the financial disclosure report for the first year of Trump's second term.
Barbara Perry, a presidential historian at the University of Virginia's Miller Center, told the BBC there is "no precedent for this," adding: "It's beyond anything we've ever seen in the presidency."

body_zh: 作者：托马斯·科普兰和艾莉森·本杰明，BBC 验证
对美国总统财务披露的审查显示，唐纳德·特朗普的投资组合今年至少购买或出售了芯片制造商英伟达 (Nvidia) 的股票 44 次。
特朗普最近公开的投资交易声明显示，1 月至 9 月期间，投资组合购买了 520 万美元至 1700 万美元（400 万英镑至 1300 万英镑）的 Nvidia 股票，并卖出了 440 万美元至 1200 万美元的股票。截至 2025 年底，他的投资组合持有 1250 万美元至 5800 万美元的 Nvidia 股票。
向政府道德办公室披露的财务信息显示交易价值存在上下波动，因此无法更准确地分析 Nvidia 股票的交易量。
英伟达近期的动荡及其股价波动并未包含在披露范围内。过去两周，联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋辞职，特朗普在他的复职中发挥了重要作用。
白宫表示，特朗普的股票和债券投资组合由第三方独立管理，他和他的家人“都没有能力指导、影响或提供有关投资组合如何投资或何时购买或出售投资的意见”。
黄在被报道发生婚外情后于 11 月 12 日辞职，其中包括与一名据称与中国情报部门有联系的女性。在他辞职的消息传出后，英伟达的股价应声下跌。
但周一，英伟达董事会宣布恢复这位 63 岁的首席执行官的职务。
特朗普告诉美国媒体，他已经“达成协议”，以“说服”这家科技巨头董事会让黄回来。该委员会表示，“已收到美国政府高层的意见”，认为他“不构成国家安全风险”。
黄仁勋回归后，英伟达股价周一飙升 31%。英伟达的市值增加了约 1 万亿美元（7,630 亿英镑），但该公司的股票交易价格仍低于黄的涉嫌事务的报道开始流传之前的价值。
然而，共和党和民主党政界人士仍然对黄仁勋的行为、英伟达遵守美国对向中国出口先进计算机芯片的管制以及特朗普参与让他重新被任命为首席执行官的行为感到担忧。
英伟达的芯片技术和投资对于人工智能（AI）行业的发展至关重要，使其成为全球最有价值的公司之一。
根据道富金融服务公司的数据，该公司目前在标准普尔 500 指数中所占比例超过 6%。这使其成为该指数中仅次于苹果公司的第二大市值公司，特朗普的账户也经常交易该公司的股票。
英伟达在许多全球指数中也排名靠前，这意味着在世界各地持有的投资账户（包括养老金）很可能包含其股票。
我们对特朗普的英伟达交易的分析不包括他持有的其他投资产品，其中可能包括其股票。
根据特朗普第二任期第一年的财务披露报告，特朗普从各种投资和商业活动中赚取了至少 22 亿美元（17 亿英镑）。
弗吉尼亚大学米勒中心的总统历史学家芭芭拉·佩里告诉英国广播公司，“这没有先例”，并补充道：“这超出了我们在总统任期内见过的任何事情。”

title_en: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade due to severe weather
title_zh: 梅西百货因恶劣天气推迟感恩节游行
summary: The was the first time ever that the iconic celebration was delayed because of storms. New York expects damaging winds and heavy rainfall over the Thanksgiving holiday.
summary_zh: 这是有史以来第一次标志性的庆祝活动因暴风雨而推迟。纽约预计塔河将出现破坏性大风和强降雨
body_en: Macy's has postponed its 100th annual Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York to Saturday because of severe weather.

Preparations to hold the iconic holiday celebration, known for its massive balloons that float among the city's skyscrapers, had already begun when the forecast for heavy rain and strong winds on Thursday led to the delay.

The last time the parade was suspended was during World War Two, but it has never been postponed due to weather. In 1971, Macy's decided to ground the balloons, which often feature beloved characters from pop culture, because of weather.
A powerful coastal storm is set to affect the New York area in coming days.
On Wednesday night, New York Governor Kathy Hochul declared a state of emergency for Long Island, New York City and Westchester County
The potent nor'easter is expected to make it too windy and dangerous for the iconic balloons to fly.

Macy's had expected to put 100 inflatables into the sky to mark its 100th parade and feature 10 new balloons, including one depicting the animated dog Bluey wearing a crown and another showing a Minion character riding a banana like a horse.

"While we are heartbroken that our parade was postponed, the safety of our partners, the safety of our participants and spectators is, and always will be, our top priority," said Will Cross, the parade's executive producer, during a news conference on Wednesday with city officials.
Cross also said the giant balloons would be deflated on Wednesday night and stored at a facility in neighbouring New Jersey until they were reinflated for the parade on Saturday.
Macy's confirmed the new parade date and updated a countdown clock on its website to reflect the Saturday schedule. Meanwhile, broadcaster NBC has said it will show the 2025 parade on Thursday.

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who will not attend the parade on Saturday because of a scheduled surgery, said at the news conference that "you have to plan for every possibility" and confirmed that "extreme weather has forced" officials to make the change.

"We know that this is an inconvenience for many who come to visit our city. This decision, however, was made with safety being paramount," he said. "We want to ensure that we're delivering a parade that's not only incredible and spectacular, but one also that doesn't come at the expense of anyone's safety."
Mamdani also said that there would be an expanded police presence along the parade route on Saturday and that there were "no known specific or credible threats to the parade at this time".

Cross added that Macy's is working through what costs it could cover as a result of the delay and said the company is in contact with bands, performers and others who travelled to the city for the parade.
During some past parades, strong winds and inclement weather have led to the tearing and deflation of the balloons as well as collisions with lampposts that caused injuries.

The US National Weather Service has issued a high wind warning, valid from 10:00 local time (15:00 GMT) on Thursday until 01:00 (06:00 GMT) on Friday with gusts potentially reaching 60mph (97km/h) - although the very strongest winds are likely to occur after the parade was due to end.
Heavy rain and coastal flooding will pose additional hazards across the eastern US as the storm sweeps through, while some inland parts could also see snow, BBC Weather reports.
The governor of the neighbouring state of New Jersey on Wednesday declared a state of emergency across the state's 21 counties, beginning at 18:00 local time (23:00 GMT).

Governor Mikie Sherrill's office said the powerful coastal storm is expected to bring damaging winds, heavy rainfall, and severe tidal flooding through Friday, with coastal and bayside communities facing the greatest risk. Sherrill urged residents to stay off the roads as much as possible once the storm arrives.

Originally called the Macy's Christmas Parade, the celebration, which also features live performers, debuted in 1924 as a way to boost holiday sales. It was founded by Macy's employees and their families.
body_zh: 由于恶劣天气，梅西百货将其在纽约举行的第 100 届年度感恩节游行推迟至周六。
这场以漂浮在城市摩天大楼之间的巨型气球而闻名的标志性节日庆祝活动的准备工作已经开始，但周四预计将有大雨和强风，导致活动推迟。
上次阅兵暂停是在第二次世界大战期间，但从未因天气原因而推迟。 1971 年，由于天气原因，梅西百货决定停飞这些气球，这些气球通常以流行文化中深受喜爱的角色为主题。
未来几天，一场强大的沿海风暴将影响纽约地区。
周三晚上，纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔宣布长岛、纽约市和威彻斯特县进入紧急状态
预计强烈的东北风将使标志性气球无法飞行，风势太大且危险。
梅西百货原计划将 100 个充气气球升上天空，以纪念其第 100 次游行，并推出 10 个新气球，其中一个描绘了戴着王冠的动画狗 Bluey，另一个描绘了像马一样骑着香蕉的小黄人角色。
游行执行制片人威尔·克罗斯在周三与市政府官员举行的新闻发布会上表示：“虽然我们对游行被推迟感到心碎，但我们合作伙伴的安全、参与者和观众的安全始终是我们的首要任务。”
克罗斯还表示，这些巨型气球将于周三晚上放气，并存放在邻近新泽西州的一个设施中，直到周六的游行时重新充气。
梅西百货确认了新的游行日期，并更新了其网站上的倒计时以反映周六的时间表。与此同时，NBC 广播公司表示将于周四转播 2025 年游行。
纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼因预定的手术而不会参加周六的游行，他在新闻发布会上表示，“你必须为每一种可能性做好计划”，并证实“极端天气迫使”官员做出改变。
“我们知道这对许多来我们城市旅游的人来说是不便的。然而，这个决定是在安全至上的情况下做出的，”他说。 “我们希望确保我们举办的游行不仅令人难以置信和壮观，而且不会以牺牲任何人的安全为代价。”
马姆达尼还表示，周六游行路线沿线将增加警力，“目前没有已知的具体或可信的游行威胁”。
克罗斯补充说，梅西百货正在研究因延误而可能产生的费用，并表示该公司正在与乐队、表演者和其他前往该市参加游行的人保持联系。
在过去的一些游行中，强风和恶劣天气导致气球撕裂、泄气，以及与灯柱相撞造成人员受伤。
美国国家气象局已发布大风警告，有效期为周四当地时间 10:00（格林威治标准时间 15:00）至周五 01:00（格林威治标准时间 06:00），阵风速度可能达到 60 英里/小时（97 公里/小时）——尽管最强风可能会在游行结束后出现。
据英国广播公司天气报道，随着风暴席卷美国东部，大雨和沿海洪水将给美国东部带来额外的危险，而一些内陆地区也可能会下雪。
周三，邻近的新泽西州州长宣布该州 21 个县从当地时间 18:00（格林威治标准时间 23:00）开始进入紧急状态。
州长米基·谢里尔(Mikie Sherrill)办公室表示，强大的沿海风暴预计将在周五带来破坏性的大风、强降雨和严重的潮汐洪水，沿海和海湾社区面临最大的风险。谢里尔敦促居民在风暴到来后尽可能远离道路。
这项庆祝活动最初称为梅西百货圣诞游行，还有现场表演者，于 1924 年首次亮相，旨在促进节日销售。它是由梅西百货的员工及其家人创立的。

title_en: More than 300 Russians killed as Moscow props up Mali’s junta, leaked data reveals
title_zh: 泄露的数据显示，莫斯科支持马里军政府导致 300 多名俄罗斯人死亡
summary: Exclusive: Records list 349 deaths in three years in Mali and also shed light on Russia’s military activity elsewhere in Africa When the attack on Kidal began before dawn on 25 April this year, the Russian fighters were caught off guard. Within the first hour,
summary_zh: 独家：记录显示马里三年内有 349 人死亡，同时也揭示了俄罗斯在非洲其他地区的军事活动
body_en: Exclusive: Records list 349 deaths in three years in Mali and also shed light on Russia’s military activity elsewhere in Africa

W hen the attack on Kidal began before dawn on 25 April this year, the Russian fighters were caught off guard. Within the first hour, checkpoints on the outskirts of the remote desert city nestled among the rocky hills of northern Mali had fallen to the insurgents, who pushed towards the police station where fierce fighting erupted.

“Everything was happening at once. Explosions were going off all around us, people were shouting,” recalled a former member of Russia’s Africa Corps who was stationed in Mali at the time and spoke on condition of anonymity. “Nobody knew where the enemy was coming from.”
Russia’s war dead: the hidden toll of the Ukraine conflict

The Kremlin-controlled forces and their Malian allies were facing a coordinated surprise assault by the al-Qaida-linked JNIM and the Tuareg-led Azawad Liberation Front (FLA), whose fighters used suicide car bombs and drones to break through the city’s defences.

Leaked Russian state records suggest the losses were heavy that day. Death certificates of Russian fighters killed in Mali , held by Rosstat, Russia’s state statistics agency, were obtained by the hacker groups Cyber Partisans and Silent Crow and analysed by the Guardian.

The records show that 43 Russians died in Mali on 25 April, including six in Kidal and one in nearby Aguelhok. Others were recorded as dying in the capital, Bamako, and in Gao, where rebels shot down a Russian military helicopter that day.

By the following morning, the Russians had abandoned Kidal, which Russian mercenaries had helped capture in November 2023 and which Moscow had since held up as a showcase of its growing influence in Africa.
In all, the records list 349 Russian deaths in Mali between September 2023 and September 2026, most of which the Guardian was able to link to known battles with rebel groups.
The figures offer a previously unseen glimpse into the human cost of Moscow’s efforts to prop up Mali’s military junta, in what has become Russia’s largest military deployment in Africa.
Two western officials who have travelled to Mali and were shown the data said the death toll was higher than previously estimated.
“That’s over 10% of Russia’s forces killed in action,” said one of the officials, speaking on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to comment publicly.
Leaked data shows more than 1,000 Russian military suicides during Ukraine war
Moscow does not publish its losses in Africa, and its foreign ministry did not respond to a request for comment.

The Wagner private military group, led by the warlord Yevgeny Prigozhin, first arrived in Mali in late 2021, a year after a military coup had toppled President Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta. French forces were ordered to leave the country as relations with the junta deteriorated, bringing an end to France’s decade-long counter-terrorism operation and leaving Russia as the regime’s main foreign protector.

Wagner handed over its operations in Mali to the Africa Corps in June 2025, two years after Prigozhin led a failed mutiny on Moscow that discredited the group in the eyes of the Kremlin. By that summer, British intelligence estimated that about 2,000 Africa Corps personnel were deployed in the country.

The Africa Corps, closely overseen by Russian military intelligence, currently provides backing to several African governments in return for payment or lucrative contracts granting access to natural resources.

Despite the Russian presence, Mali’s security situation has continued to deteriorate. In late July 2024, Russian and Malian forces fought Tuareg separatists for several days near Tinzaouaten, on the Algerian border.
Wagner at the time issued a rare statement admitting losses, including the death of a commander, but gave no figure. Estimates from Russian sources ranged from about 20 to more than 80 dead.
body_zh: 独家：记录显示马里三年内有 349 人死亡，同时也揭示了俄罗斯在非洲其他地区的军事活动
W hen the attack on Kidal began before dawn on 25 April this year, the Russian fighters were caught off guard.在第一个小时内，这座坐落在马里北部岩石山丘之间的偏远沙漠城市郊区的检查站就被叛乱分子占领，他们向警察局推进，在那里爆发了激烈的战斗。
“一切都同时发生。我们周围爆炸，人们大喊大叫，”一位当时驻扎在马里的前俄罗斯非洲军团成员回忆道，他不愿透露姓名。 “没有人知道敌人从哪里来。”
俄罗斯的战争死难者：乌克兰冲突的隐性伤亡
克里姆林宫控制的部队及其马里盟友正面临与基地组织有联系的 JNIM 和图阿雷格人领导的阿扎瓦德解放阵线 (FLA) 的协调突然袭击，该阵线的战士使用自杀式汽车炸弹和无人机突破了该市的防御。
泄露的俄罗斯国家记录显示，当天损失惨重。黑客组织 Cyber​​ Partisans 和 Silent Crow 获得了俄罗斯国家统计机构 Rosstat 持有的在马里阵亡的俄罗斯战士的死亡证明，并由《卫报》进行了分析。
记录显示，4 月 25 日有 43 名俄罗斯人在马里死亡，其中 6 人死于基达尔，1 人死于附近的阿盖洛克。据记录，首都巴马科和加奥的其他人死亡，叛军当天击落了一架俄罗斯军用直升机。
到第二天早上，俄罗斯人已经放弃了基达尔，俄罗斯雇佣军于 2023 年 11 月帮助占领了基达尔，莫斯科此后一直将基达尔作为其在非洲日益增长的影响力的展示。
总而言之，记录列出了 2023 年 9 月至 2026 年 9 月期间，俄罗斯人在马里死亡 349 人，《卫报》能够将其中大部分与已知的与叛乱组织的战斗联系起来。
这些数字让人们得以一睹莫斯科为支持马里军政府而付出的人力代价，这已成为俄罗斯在非洲最大规模的军事部署。
两名前往马里并看到数据的西方官员表示，死亡人数高于之前的估计。
一位不愿透露姓名的官员表示，“超过 10% 的俄罗斯军队在行动中阵亡”，因为他们无权公开发表评论。
泄露数据显示乌克兰战争期间已有1000多名俄罗斯军人自杀
莫斯科没有公布其在非洲的损失，其外交部也没有回应置评请求。
由军阀叶夫根尼·普里戈任 (Yevgeny Prigozhin) 领导的瓦格纳私人军事团体于 2021 年底首次抵达马里，一年前，一场军事政变推翻了总统易卜拉欣·布巴卡尔·凯塔 (Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta)。随着与军政府关系恶化，法国军队被勒令撤离该国，结束了法国长达十年的反恐行动，俄罗斯成为该政权的主要外国保护者。
瓦格纳于 2025 年 6 月将其在马里的行动移交给了非洲军团，两年前，普里戈任在莫斯科领导了一场失败的叛变，导致该组织在克里姆林宫眼中名誉扫地。到那年夏天，英国情报机构估计约有 2,000 名非洲军团人员部署在该国。
受到俄罗斯军事情报部门密切监督的非洲军团目前向多个非洲政府提供支持，以换取报酬或获得自然资源的利润丰厚的合同。
尽管有俄罗斯的存在，马里的安全局势仍在继续恶化。 2024 年 7 月下旬，俄罗斯和马里军队在阿尔及利亚边境廷扎瓦滕附近与图阿雷格分裂分子进行了数天的战斗。
瓦格纳当时发表了一份罕见的声明，承认损失，包括一名指挥官的死亡，但没有透露具体数字。俄罗斯消息来源估计死亡人数从 20 人到 80 多人不等。

North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has urged his country to focus on deploying tactical nuclear weapons “across multiple domains for different missions”.
Kim said North Korea’s nuclear material production capacity was being systematically expanded on Thursday, according to state media KCNA.

Maintaining North Korea’s status as a nuclear-weapons state was “absolutely inviolable”, Kim said during an inspection of nuclear material production and weapons research facilities. KCNA did not identify the facilities or their locations.
The country’s status would not change because of what he called “denuclearisation rhetoric from forces that ignore objective reality and failed to recognise the changed situation”.
“Our nuclear capability is now a reality,” he said, calling recent achievements in nuclear weapons production a major success in carrying ⁠⁠out the country’s nuclear policy.
Any attempt to deny North Korea’s nuclear status, which it enshrined in its constitution in 2023, would be regarded as “an open declaration of war”, he said.

Kim said diversified use of tactical nuclear weapons was an “important and urgent task raised from tactical nukes’ military value in modern warfare and from the inevitable reality facing the border with the most dangerous enemy state”.

Kim’s statements come during a growing border dispute with South Korea over a landmine explosion that injured three South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), a heavily fortified territory between the two countries, on September 21.
Seoul demanded an apology from Pyongyang in October after a joint South Korea-United Nations investigation found that North Korea had planted the landmines more than a year ago.

Pyongyang sent a letter to the UN Security Council in response, accusing Seoul of fabricating the explosion, and fired about 10 short-range ballistic missiles off its east coast into the Sea of Japan less than a week later.
South Korea estimates that North Korea possesses between 80 and 120 nuclear warheads.

金正恩在视察核材料生产和武器研究设施时表示，维持朝鲜作为核武器国家的地位“绝对不可侵犯”。朝中社没有透露这些设施或其位置。

“我们的核能力现在已成为现实，”他说，并称最近在核武器生产方面取得的成就是执行国家核政策的重大成功。

title_en: At least 31 killed as fuel tanker crash ignites large fire on Cairo highway
title_zh: 开罗高速公路油罐车相撞引发大火 至少31人死亡
summary: Blaze on ring road surrounding Egyptian capital injures at least 21 people and leaves cars and motorcycles charred A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a huge fire on a highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, Egyptian authorities
summary_zh: 埃及首都周边环路起火，造成至少21人受伤，汽车和摩托车烧焦 一起油罐车起火事故
body_en: Blaze on ring road surrounding Egyptian capital injures at least 21 people and leaves cars and motorcycles charred
A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a huge fire on a highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, Egyptian authorities said.

The blaze on the ring road, a key artery that encircles the Egyptian capital, also injured at least 21 people and left more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred, according to the latest figures released by the health ministry.

State media reported that the fire broke out when the fuel truck overturned. The stretch of the highway where it occurred was in Waraq, a densely populated neighbourhood in Giza, part of the Greater Cairo area, the health ministry said.

At the scene, rescue workers were pulling people out of burning cars. An Associated Press video showed firefighters working to put out the fire spreading among the cars. Hundreds of people gathered near the scene.
Ahmed Sameer, who was stuck in traffic as the road was blocked after the accident, saw the fuel truck and many cars on fire. He said he saw at least eight bodies being removed from burned cars.
“It was a huge fire, the cars got stuck together because of the fire,” he said, describing the fear and panic that followed. “It was a shocking scene.”
The Egyptian president, Abdel Fatah al-Sisi, expressed his condolences to the victims in a statement. The public prosecutor’s office said DNA investigations were under way to identify the victims.

The health minister, Khaled Abdel Ghaffar, said the injured were taken to nearby hospitals and that he would head to the scene. He said the death toll was preliminary, raising concerns it could rise further.

Deadly traffic incidents claim thousands of lives every year in Egypt, which has a poor transportation safety record. Speeding, bad roads and poor enforcement of traffic laws are the main reasons behind most of the crashes.
In January, 21 people were killed and 16 were injured in a multicar pileup on a road near the southern province of Beni Suef.
body_zh: 埃及首都周边环路起火，造成至少21人受伤，汽车和摩托车烧焦
埃及当局称，周三，一辆油罐车相撞，在开罗周边的一条高速公路上引发大火，造成至少 31 人死亡。
根据卫生部公布的最新数据，环绕埃及首都的主要干道环城公路起火，还造成至少 21 人受伤，两打以上汽车和摩托车被烧焦。
官方媒体报道说，加油车翻倒时起火。卫生部表示，发生事故的高速公路路段位于瓦拉克，这是大开罗地区吉萨人口稠密的社区。
在现场，救援人员正在将人们从燃烧的汽车中救出。美联社的一段视频显示，消防队员正在努力扑灭汽车中蔓延的火势。数百人聚集在现场附近。
事故发生后，道路被封锁，艾哈迈德·萨米尔（Ahmed Sameer）陷入交通堵塞，他看到加油车和许多汽车起火。他说他看到至少八具尸体从烧毁的汽车中被移走。
“那是一场大火，汽车因为火而粘在一起，”他描述了随之而来的恐惧和恐慌。 “这是一个令人震惊的场景。”
埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西在一份声明中向遇难者表示哀悼。检察官办公室表示，正在进行 DNA 调查以确定受害者身份。
卫生部长哈立德·阿卜杜勒·加法尔 (Khaled Abdel Ghaffar) 表示，伤者已被送往附近的医院，他将前往现场。他表示，死亡人数只是初步统计，令人担心死亡人数可能会进一步上升。
交通安全记录不佳的埃及，每年都会造成数千人丧生。超速、路况不佳和交通法规执行不力是大多数车祸背后的主要原因。
1 月，南部贝尼苏韦夫省附近的一条道路上发生多车连环相撞事故，造成 21 人死亡、16 人受伤。

title_zh: 美国陆军称爱荷华州的可控爆炸是“巨大成功”
summary: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.
summary_zh: 尽管爆炸前居民普遍担心，但官员们表示，到目前为止，该地区的铅含量显示前景乐观。
body_en: The US military has hailed as a "huge success" the detonation of nearly five tonnes of toxic explosives in Iowa, an operation that sparked fears of health and environmental problems across the region.
Smoke was seen rising into the sky shortly after 09:00 local time (14:00 GMT) following the explosion, as the Army declared the risk "as close to zero as is absolutely humanly possible".
Plans to detonate the lead azide, a volatile compound reportedly at risk of exploding on its own, were paused several times before the blast following public outcry and legal challenges.
On Wednesday evening, the Army said that an "all clear" has been issued around the ammunition plant.
President Donald Trump said shortly after the blast that reports showed mitigation efforts "far exceeded expectations".
"The Army's controlled, mitigated detonation exceeded all expectations and was a HUGE success," Adam Telle, acting secretary of the US Army, wrote on social media.
Despite widespread concern from residents of Middletown, Iowa, ahead of the blast, officials have said that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.

In a Wednesday evening update on X, the Army said that the Federal Emergency Management Agency (Fema) had issued the "all clear" around the plant and that there was no airborne lead detection following the detonation.
"Post-detonation surface sampling is underway, and results will be released once complete," the Army added.
Environmental Protection Agency administrator Lee Zeldin also said on social media that in the hours after the detonation "all EPA air monitors continue to report a ZERO DETECT of airborne lead".

The explosives had been in storage for around 20 years, and degraded as part of a process known as recrystallisation - this made them more responsive to accidental detonation from friction or other movement.
No level of lead exposure is considered safe, with children and pregnant women particularly vulnerable to harmful effects.
Middletown Mayor Rodney Johnson told the BBC he felt "relieved" after the detonation.
He watched the blast from his job at a manufacturing plant eight miles (12km) away from the blast - and monitored a camera at his two-bedroom home just one mile from the detonation site.
"We did not feel anything. We did not see anything," Johnson said.
Also eight miles away from Middletown, Sandy Mabeus closed the windows and the garage at her home, brought their outdoor cat inside and hunkered down.
The family watched three separate live streams on iPads and televisions of the explosion as it happened.
"We did not feel or hear a thing here," she told the BBC, adding that she checked the videos to confirm it had actually happened.
"The waiting and wondering has not been a good thing for anybody in the area," she said. "Hopefully they had a very good result and we can just get on with things."

Iowa farmer David Vandenberg lives about 20 miles from the blast site and said he first learned of the detonation around two weeks ago. The Army Corps of Engineers took samples from his yard and pond on Tuesday.
body_zh: 美国军方称赞在爱荷华州引爆近五吨有毒爆炸物的行动取得了“巨大成功”，这一行动引发了对该地区健康和环境问题的担忧。
爆炸发生后，当地时间 09:00（格林威治标准时间 14:00）后不久，烟雾升腾，陆军宣布风险“在人类绝对可能的范围内接近于零”。
据报道，叠氮化铅是一种挥发性化合物，有自行爆炸的危险，引爆计划在爆炸前因公众强烈抗议和法律挑战而多次暂停。
周三晚间，陆军表示弹药厂周围已发布“警报解除”令。
唐纳德·特朗普总统在爆炸发生后不久表示，报告显示缓解措施“远远超出预期”。
美国陆军代理部长亚当·泰勒在社交媒体上写道：“陆军控制、减轻的爆炸超出了所有人的预期，取得了巨大成功。”
尽管爆炸发生前，爱荷华州米德尔敦的居民普遍担心，但官员们表示，到目前为止，该地区的铅含量显示前景乐观。
在周三晚间 X 台的最新消息中，陆军表示，联邦紧急事务管理局 (FEMA) 已向工厂周围发出“警报解除”信号，爆炸后没有检测到空气中的铅。
陆军补充说：“爆炸后表面采样正在进行中，结果将在完成后发布。”
环境保护局局长李·泽尔丁也在社交媒体上表示，爆炸发生后的几个小时内，“美国环保局所有空气监测仪继续报告空气中铅的检测结果为零”。
这些炸药已经储存了大约 20 年，并在重结晶过程中降解，这使得它们对摩擦或其他运动引起的意外爆炸更加敏感。
任何水平的铅暴露都不被认为是安全的，儿童和孕妇特别容易受到有害影响。
米德尔敦市长罗德尼·约翰逊告诉英国广播公司，爆炸发生后他感到“如释重负”。
他在距爆炸地点 8 英里（12 公里）的一家制造工厂工作，观看了爆炸，并在距离爆炸地点仅 1 英里的两居室住宅中监控了摄像头。
“我们没有感觉到任何东西。我们没有看到任何东西，”约翰逊说。
同样距离米德尔敦八英里，桑迪·马比斯关上了家里的窗户和车库，把户外的猫带进屋里，蹲下来。
当爆炸发生时，一家人通过 iPad 和电视观看了三个独立的直播。
“我们在这里没有感觉到或听到任何事情，”她告诉英国广播公司，并补充说她检查了视频以确认这件事确实发生过。
“等待和疑惑对于该地区的任何人来说都不是一件好事，”她说。 “希望他们能取得很好的结果，我们可以继续前进。”
爱荷华州农民戴维·范登堡 (David Vandenberg) 住在距离爆炸现场约 20 英里的地方，他说他是在大约两周前第一次得知爆炸的。周二，陆军工程兵团从他的院子和池塘采集了样本。

title_en: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?
title_zh: 全球圣战主义是否失败了，还是只是改变了形式？
summary: Jihadist groups appear to be focusing on local issues rather than global terror. Does it signify a real change?
summary_zh: 圣战组织似乎关注的是当地问题，而不是全球恐怖主义。这是否意味着真正的改变？
body_en: Chief jihadist media specialist, BBC Monitoring

Rice, pasta, sugar, cooking oil and beans are hardly what you'd expect to see in jihadist propaganda. Yet these were among the supplies that al-Qaeda's Somali branch, al-Shabab, said its "charity" had handed out to hundreds of struggling families in August, as it publicised the aid through its social media accounts and radio station.
The group, which controls large parts of rural southern and central Somalia, has been keen to show off its so-called humanitarian work throughout 2026.
"May God reward them," said a local woman in one of al-Shabab's videos.
It's all part of an effort to win over local communities and present itself as more than just a jihadist group.

A quarter of a century after al-Qaeda's 9/11 attacks in the US, and 12 years after Islamic State group (IS) declared its so-called caliphate in Iraq and Syria, the jihadist movement looks very different.

Rather than focusing on attacking the West or fighting for a global Islamic state, some - especially those linked to al-Qaeda - are putting more effort into winning power closer to home. And they seem increasingly willing to make compromises along the way.

Because of this, a debate is growing within the movement. While hardliners reject compromise, pragmatists see working with local groups and former enemies as a way to gain power. But do the pragmatists represent a genuine change or simply a shift in tactics to achieve the same ultimate goals: establishing a state that applies their strict interpretation of Islamic Sharia law both at home and in its dealings with the outside world?
Neither al-Qaeda nor IS has achieved its ultimate dream: taking over one or more countries and ruling them according to their strict interpretation of Islam.

Both have suffered major defeats, lost leaders and faced years of international pressure. IS, which once controlled vast areas of Iraq and Syria, lost its last territorial stronghold in 2019. But jihadism hasn't gone away.

Africa is now the main battleground for jihadism, with al-Qaeda's powerful branches, JNIM in the Sahel (Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger) and al-Shabab in Somalia, fighting long-running insurgencies. IS, its bitter rival, has active branches in Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Sahel, Mozambique and Somalia.

One major source of inspiration, and envy, whether jihadists admit it or not, is Syria's new president, Ahmed al-Sharaa . The former IS and then al-Qaeda commander was once wanted by the US but rose to power in Syria in December 2024 and was welcomed by Western leaders.
Once known by his militant nom de guerre Abu Mohammed al-Jolani, he led the jihadist group Nusra Front - initially linked to IS and then al-Qaeda - and later the group Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS).
He gradually broke ties with both IS and al-Qaeda and distanced himself from their calls for global jihad.
Instead, he focused on Syria, building a local power base in the north-western Idlib province.

What surprised everyone was his growing willingness to work with non-Islamist groups and engage with foreign powers. As HTS advanced on Damascus, its leadership sought to reassure the international community, reaching out even to Russia, a key ally of then-president Bashar al-Assad, to allay fears of an Islamist takeover.
That pragmatism, combined with favourable geopolitical conditions - including a weaker Russia and Iran - helped him take power in Syria.
But the sight of him being welcomed by world leaders, including US President Donald Trump, was even more remarkable.
During Sharaa's visit to the White House in November 2025, Trump sprayed him with his own branded cologne, jokingly asked how many wives he had and praised him as a "very strong leader".
For some jihadists, Sharaa's success has been inspiring. Others, however, see his actions as a betrayal of everything they believe in.
body_zh: 英国广播公司监控首席圣战媒体专家
大米、面食、糖、食用油和豆类在圣战宣传中几乎是你想象不到的。然而，基地组织索马里分支青年党表示，其“慈善机构”已在 8 月份向数百个陷入困境的家庭发放了这些物资，并通过社交媒体账户和广播电台宣传了这些援助。
该组织控制着索马里南部和中部大部分农村地区，一直热衷于在 2026 年炫耀其所谓的人道主义工作。
“愿上帝奖励他们，”一名当地妇女在青年党的视频中说道。
这都是为了赢得当地社区的支持，并让自己不仅仅是一个圣战组织。
基地组织在美国发动 9/11 袭击 25 年后，伊斯兰国组织 (IS) 在伊拉克和叙利亚宣布建立所谓的哈里发国 12 年后，圣战运动看起来已大不相同。
一些人——尤其是那些与基地组织有联系的人——不再专注于攻击西方或为全球伊斯兰国家而战，而是投入更多努力来赢得离本土较近的权力。而且他们似乎越来越愿意在此过程中做出妥协。
正因为如此，运动内部的争论日益激烈。虽然强硬派拒绝妥协，但实用主义者认为与当地团体和前敌人合作是获得权力的一种方式。但实用主义者代表的是真正的改变还是仅仅是策略上的转变，以实现相同的最终目标：建立一个在国内和与外界打交道时严格执行其对伊斯兰教法的解释的国家？
基地组织和伊斯兰国都没有实现其最终梦想：接管一个或多个国家并按照他们对伊斯兰教的严格解释来统治它们。
两国都遭受了重大失败，失去了领导人，并面临多年的国际压力。曾经控制伊拉克和叙利亚大片地区的“伊斯兰国”组织在 2019 年失去了最后一个领土据点。但圣战主义并没有消失。
非洲现在是圣战主义的主战场，基地组织的强大分支、萨赫勒地区（马里、布基纳法索和尼日尔）的青年伊斯兰运动和索马里的青年党正在打击长期的叛乱活动。它的死对头“伊斯兰国”在尼日利亚、刚果民主共和国、萨赫勒地区、莫桑比克和索马里都有活跃的分支机构。
无论圣战分子承认与否，叙利亚新总统艾哈迈德·沙拉都是灵感和嫉妒的主要来源。这位前“伊斯兰国”、当时的基地组织指挥官曾被美国通缉，但于2024年12月在叙利亚上台，并受到西方领导人的​​欢迎。
他曾以激进的化名阿布·穆罕默德·乔拉尼 (Abu Mohammed al-Jolani) 为人所知，领导着圣战组织“努斯拉阵线”(Nusra Front)——最初与“伊斯兰国”(IS)、后来与“基地”组织有联系——以及后来的组织“沙姆解放组织”(HTS)。
他逐渐与“伊斯兰国”和“基地”组织断绝关系，并与他们呼吁的全球圣战保持距离。
相反，他将重点放在叙利亚，在西北部伊德利卜省建立当地权力基地。
令所有人惊讶的是，他越来越愿意与非伊斯兰团体合作并与外国势力接触。随着“伊斯兰国”向大马士革挺进，其领导层试图安抚国际社会，甚至与时任总统巴沙尔·阿萨德的重要盟友俄罗斯进行接触，以减轻对伊斯兰主义接管的担忧。
这种实用主义，加上有利的地缘政治条件——包括实力较弱的俄罗斯和伊朗——帮助他在叙利亚掌权。
但他受到包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在内的世界领导人的欢迎的景象更加引人注目。
2025年11月沙拉访问白宫期间，特朗普给他喷了自己品牌的古龙水，开玩笑地问他有多少个妻子，并称赞他是“非常强势的领导人”。
对于一些圣战分子来说，沙拉的成功鼓舞人心。然而，其他人则认为他的行为背叛了他们所信仰的一切。

title_en: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt settle legal battle over French winery
title_zh: 安吉丽娜·朱莉和布拉德·皮特就法国酒庄的法律纠纷达成和解
summary: The Hollywood A-listers' legal battle focused on the vineyard they bought in 2008 and where they wed six years later.
summary_zh: 这对好莱坞一线明星的法律诉讼主要集中在他们 2008 年购买的葡萄园以及六年后他们结婚的地方。
body_en: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have settled a long-running legal battle over her sale of a stake in their French vineyard, which unfolded amid a bitter divorce.
"We have settled out of court in the best interests of our family and will not be commenting further," said the Hollywood stars' representatives in a joint statement.
They bought a controlling interest in Château Miraval in 2008 and wed there six years later.

In the lawsuit, Pitt , 62 , argued that Jolie, 51, acted without his permission in selling her share in the winery to a Russian oligarch. She counter-sued, accusing Pitt of drunkenly attacking her and their children on a flight, prompting her to file for divorce in 2016.
The settlement announced on Wednesday resolves both of their respective legal actions.
"Any comments in media stories attributed to 'sources' are in fact not coming from either of us, or anyone close to us," said the statement from their representatives.

Pitt's lawsuit had accused Jolie of seeking "to inflict harm" on him when she sold her stake in their co-owned vineyard, which he claimed had forced him to partner with "a stranger with poisonous associations and intentions".
The Fight Club star said he and Jolie had agreed not to sell their stakes in the venue without the permission of the other.
It was alleged that Jolie had sold her share to a Luxembourg-based spirits manufacturer controlled by Russian oligarch Yuri Shefler, without Pitt's knowledge.
Jolie hit back with her own lawsuit, accusing Pitt of grabbing her by the head and attacking two of their children during a 2016 private jet flight trip.
Pitt also verbally abused and poured alcohol on his family during the flight from France to Los Angeles, her lawsuit had alleged.
Her lawyers alleged Pitt began shouting, accusing her of being "too deferential" to their six children - aged eight to 15 at the time.
Pitt was not charged following a police investigation into the incident and he denied the allegations.
They reached a divorce settlement late last year after an eight-year legal battle.
It is understood that Pitt's litigation with Stoli Group, a beverage company owned by the Russian oligarch, is ongoing.
At the time of their 2014 marriage, Pitt and Jolie were among the most lucrative names in Hollywood.
They met on the set of the 2005 film Mr and Mrs Smith and were soon dubbed Brangelina by the press.
The marriage was Pitt's second after a relationship with Friends star Jennifer Aniston.
It was Jolie's third, after actors Billy Bob Thornton and Jonny Lee Miller.
Jolie adopted her first child, Maddox, from Cambodia in 2002 a few months after he was born. Pitt later adopted him after he and Jolie had begun their relationship.
body_zh: 布拉德·皮特 (Brad Pitt) 和安吉丽娜·朱莉 (Angelina Jolie) 就她出售法国葡萄园股份的长期法律纠纷达成和解，这场诉讼是在一场激烈的离婚中展开的。
好莱坞明星的代表在一份联合声明中表示：“为了我们家庭的最大利益，我们已经在庭外和解，不会进一步发表评论。”
他们于 2008 年购买了 Château Miraval 的控股权，并于六年后在那里结婚。
在诉讼中，62 岁的皮特辩称，51 岁的朱莉未经他的许可，将自己在酒庄的股份出售给俄罗斯寡头。她反诉，指控皮特在飞机上醉酒后袭击她和他们的孩子，促使她于 2016 年提出离婚。
周三宣布的和解协议解决了他们各自的法律诉讼。
他们的代表在声明中表示：“媒体报道中任何归因于‘消息来源’的评论实际上都不是来自我们任何人或任何与我们关系密切的人。”
皮特的诉讼指控朱莉在出售他们共同拥有的葡萄园的股份时试图“对他造成伤害”，皮特声称这迫使他与“一个具有恶意联想和意图的陌生人”合作。
这位搏击俱乐部明星表示，他和朱莉已经同意，未经对方许可，不会出售他们在该场馆的股份。
据称，朱莉在皮特不知情的情况下，将自己的股份出售给了俄罗斯寡头尤里·谢夫勒控制的卢森堡烈酒制造商。
朱莉以自己的诉讼进行回击，指控皮特在 2016 年私人飞机旅行期间抓住她的头并攻击他们的两个孩子。
皮特的诉讼称，在从法国飞往洛杉矶的航班上，皮特还对家人进行辱骂并向家人泼酒。
她的律师称，皮特开始大喊大叫，指责她对他们当时年龄在 8 岁至 15 岁之间的六个孩子“过于恭敬”。
警方对事件进行调查后，皮特没有受到指控，他否认了这些指控。
经过八年的法律斗争后，他们于去年年底达成离婚协议。
据了解，皮特与俄罗斯寡头旗下饮料公司斯托利集团的诉讼正在进行中。
2014 年结婚时，皮特和朱莉是好莱坞最赚钱的名字之一。
他们在 2005 年电影《史密斯夫妇》片场相识，很快就被媒体称为 Brangelina。
这是皮特继与《老友记》明星詹妮弗·安妮斯顿交往后的第二次婚姻。
这是朱莉继演员比利·鲍勃·松顿和约翰·李·米勒之后的第三次获奖。
2002 年，朱莉从柬埔寨收养了她的第一个孩子马多克斯 (Maddox)，当时他出生几个月。在他和朱莉开始交往后，皮特收养了他。

title_en: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
title_zh: 油罐车在开罗高速公路坠毁，大火造成31人死亡
summary: Another 21 are injured after the tanker reportedly overturns on a busy ring road in the Egyptian capital.
summary_zh: 据报道，这艘油轮在埃及首都一条繁忙的环路上翻车，另有 21 人受伤。
body_en: Thirty-one people have been killed and 21 others injured in a large fire on a busy highway in Cairo after a fuel tanker crashed, Egypt's health ministry says.

Hospitals nearby treated patients suffering burns and smoke inhalation after the incident, which occurred on a section of a ring road in the Warraq neighbourhood, to the north of the old city centre, on Wednesday evening.
Footage circulating on social media showed billowing flames and black smoke towering high into the night sky, with multiple nearby vehicles torched.
Officials have not given an account of how the fire broke out, but state-owned media reported the tanker had overturned, dousing nearby vehicles with petrol.
The regional public prosecutor has launched an investigation into the incident and asked that DNA samples be taken from bodies of the dead.

The tanker, which belonged to a private contractor, had been travelling along the highway when a high-voltage cable fell in front of it, prompting the driver to lose control, Al-Ahram reports, citing sources with knowledge of the investigation.
It then crossed the central reservation, overturned and caught fire, the state-owned newspaper says.

Egypt has suffered several deadly fires in recent years, with informal residential areas and often run-down infrastructure making incidents more common, the response to which is often complicated by slow emergency response times and locally improvised rescue efforts, even in the sprawling Egyptian capital.
Images from the scene show a large crowd gathered on the highway after the fire had been extinguished, as emergency services blocked off entry routes.

The health ministry said 39 ambulances had been dispatched to respond to the fire, while it posted images of Egypt's health minister overseeing the treatment of the injured at one of Cairo's hospitals.
Road collisions are also common in Egypt, often attributed to lax maintenance and the widespread flouting of traffic laws.
Nearly 6,000 people died on Egypt's roads last year, official figures show, a rise of several hundred on the previous year's total.
Emergency responders have since cleared the highway and allowed it to reopen, state broadcaster NMA reports.
A bulldozer could earlier be seen at the scene clearing the burnt-out wrecks of cars.
body_zh: 埃及卫生部称，开罗一条繁忙高速公路上一辆油罐车坠毁后发生大火，造成 31 人死亡、21 人受伤。
周三晚间，位于旧市中心以北的沃拉克街区的环路一段发生了这起事件，事件发生后，附近的医院正在治疗烧伤和吸入烟雾的患者。
社交媒体上流传的视频显示，滚滚火焰和黑烟直冲夜空，附近多辆汽车被烧毁。
官员们尚未说明火灾是如何发生的，但官方媒体报道称，油罐车已经倾覆，附近车辆被汽油浇灭。
地区检察官已对此事件展开调查，并要求从死者尸体中提取DNA样本。
金字塔报援引了解调查情况的消息人士报道称，这辆油罐车属于一家私人承包商，当时它正在高速公路上行驶，一条高压电缆掉在了它前面，导致司机失去控制。
该国有报纸称，随后它穿过了中央保留区，翻倒并起火。
近年来，埃及遭受了多起致命火灾，非正规住宅区和经常破旧的基础设施使火灾事件变得更加常见，而紧急响应时间缓慢和当地临时救援工作往往使应对工作变得复杂，即使在面积庞大的埃及首都也是如此。
现场图像显示，大火被扑灭后，大量人群聚集在高速公路上，紧急服务部门封锁了入口路线。
卫生部表示，已派出 39 辆救护车前往救火，同时发布了埃及卫生部长在开罗一家医院监督伤者治疗的照片。
道路碰撞在埃及也很常见，通常归因于维护不严和普遍违反交通法规。
官方数据显示，去年埃及有近 6,000 人死于道路事故，比前一年的总数增加了数百人。
据国家广播公司 NMA 报道，紧急救援人员已清理了高速公路并允许其重新开放。
早些时候可以看到现场有一辆推土机正在清理烧毁的汽车残骸。
